ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field centrally; low-intensity black contiguous banding along the trailing edge and a dark localized cluster at the insertion point with the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with distinct pixel-level peaks and valleys forming a jagged linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible lobe follows an elongated convex curve tapering from the midline toward the distal tip.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark pigmentation mottling/spotting localized near the posterior-lateral margin of the white ventral field.
